## Projects Department Health & Safety Standards

## Ref: EGY/PRJCTS/HSE/REQs

- ?Actively seeking opportunities to be involved in health and safety activities like accident investigations, attending frontline health and safety meetings and briefings
- ? Managing risk by asking the right questions and insisting on timely, accurate and impartial information
- ·Regularly monitoring health and safety performance
- ?Recognizing contributions and health and safety achievements and looking for meaningful ways to celebrate health and safety successes

## 2.4.1.4. Commitment:

- A Commitment is vital to improving health and safety performance. Generally commitment to health and safety is typically focused on management's efforts to show that health and safety is a top priorityto the organization.
- Senior staff must be seen to lead by example when it comes to health and safety. Managers must be seen regularly around work areas to discuss and talk about health and safety and visibly demonstrate their commitment by their actions, such as stopping activities to resolve issues.
- It is important that management is perceived as sincerely committed to health and safety, if not, people will generally assume that they are expected to put production first and ignore the requirements of health and safety.
- As with leadership, commitment is about doing the right thing rather than saying the right thing.
- Although strong health and safety performance begins with top level management it is how health and safety is implemented through the collective behaviors of all staff and workers that will ultimatelyinfluence the overall health and safetyperformance.

## 2.4.1.5. Communication:

- Good health and safety relies on effective written and oral communications, where there will be a multitude of different nationalities and languages across individual workforces and projects as a whole.
- Program Partners shall establish a communication system among managers, supervisory personnel, safety personnel, workers and Subcontractors. The communication system shall consist of the Coordination Meetings, H&S Committee Meeting, Pre-Work/Tool Box Meetings, and any other meeting necessary to conform to any regulatory requirements and Beyond Zero aims and values. Group meetings shall:
- Review and discuss all Site HSE matters of the employees
- ? Review safeworkpractices
- Co-ordinate jobs so that the work does not pose a hazard to others

- D InformPersonnel ofpotentiallydangerousWorksoperationson theSite
